## Activity

During January 2025, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 385 captures. This figure represents the activity reported for the month. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. The activity record has been presented without additional adjustment or interpretation.

## Image quality

Of the 385 captures, 13 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.4%. This rate and count are reported together to provide a clear view of image quality during January 2025. The findings indicate the proportion of captures that could not proceed through grading because the images were ungradable.

## Grading

There were 100 referable results. The median grading lag was 9. This measure summarises the time taken for grading across the reported results. The activity, image quality, and grading figures should be considered together when reviewing the month’s operational performance at West Gate Eye Clinic.
